goal: Produce Phase 4B Research Constraints for the approved two-section complex platformer prototype, covering layout, hazard or moving obstacle behavior, collectible or progression state, UI state, camera/readability, feel constraints, and Art/Implementation/QA handoffs without starting art production or Godot implementation.
inputs: BK/Human Creative Owner chat approval on 2026-06-13 to accept WP-030 scope and proceed to WP-031

verify.name: Research note covers selected complexity constraints
verify.command: rg -n "Layout Constraints|Hazard|Moving Obstacle|Collectible|Progression State|UI State|Camera|Readability|Feel Constraints|Art Handoff|Implementation Handoff|QA Handoff|Uncertainty" research_notes/RN-2026W22-003-phase4b-complex-prototype-reference.md

acceptance_criteria: The Research note maps directly to the approved Phase 4B scope: two-section level flow, one hazard or moving obstacle, collectible or progression state, UI state, camera behavior, imported gameplay-readable art needs, and player-facing feel gate.
The note gives Art Agent enough constraints to define asset requirements and review surfaces without selecting final art direction or producing assets in this slice.
The note gives Implementation Agent enough constraints for later Godot planning without editing Godot files or approving implementation in this slice.
The note gives QA Agent concrete risks and checks for reachability, hazard readability, progression reset behavior, UI state, camera framing, and owner-play readiness.
The note includes source or rationale, uncertainty, and explicit handoffs.
No Godot files, art assets, owner review artifacts, QA reviews, Learning Cards, schemas, agent profiles, lifecycle moves, or git operations are changed by WP-031 execution.
notes: BK/Human Creative Owner approved the WP-030 Phase 4B scope in chat on 2026-06-13 and instructed Codex to proceed to WP-031 creation. This Work Package authorizes Research Constraints only and stops before Art requirements, owner review, Godot implementation, QA, learning capture, closeout, staging, committing, or pushing.
